update.title: Audited and repaired the Constellation registry
update.summary: Repaired VCSH command paths, brought overlooked integration files under ownership, and resolved package issues discovered by a full registry audit.

blocks.body:
## Audit ownership across the fleet

A fleet-wide audit checks repository health, integration-file ownership, and commands from outside the workspace root. It exposes add commands that depend on the caller’s current directory and local hook or configuration files that are not recognized by package ownership rules.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Observe[Observe repository state] --> Classify[Classify ownership]
  Classify --> Shared{Shared cause?}
  Shared -->|Yes| Rule[Repair common rule]
  Shared -->|No| Package[Repair owning package]
  Rule --> Validate[Validate entire affected fleet]
  Package --> Validate
blocks.description: The audit distinguished common infrastructure faults from package-local cleanup instead of suppressing both with broad ignores.

blocks.body:
## Fix the rule at the right level

VCSH commands establish their working directory, while discovery recognizes the local integration-file forms used by packages. I repaired output locations, stale paths, and ignore rules in the packages that owned them. Package-specific repairs also corrected Portfolio Site’s preview-image paths so detail pages and editor previews could load the intended images.

blocks.code:
packages valid               63 / 63
untracked integration files   0
ownership violations          0
touched repositories clean   14 / 14
blocks.description: The audit closes only after ownership and validation checks return clean across the affected fleet.
